def: Serving or tending to elaborate; constructing with labor andminute attention to details. Elaborative faculty (Metaph.), theintellectual power of discerning relations and of viewing objects bymeans of, or in, relations; the discursive faculty; thought.
To cry as a cat; to squall; to wail. [Written also wawl.]The helpless infant, coming wauling and crying into the world. Sir W.Scott.
The aggregate value of the different stocks in which a loan togovernment is now usually funded. M'Culloch.
Slender rods or tubes of colored glass fused together andembedded in clear glass; -- used for paperweights and other smallarticles.
A vascular sac connected, beneath the brain, in many fishes,with the infundibulum.
A silvered aromatic pill, used to correct the odor of thebreath.
Merchantlike; suitable to the character or business of amerchant. [Obs.] Gauden.
To inhere or exist together, as in one substance. Sir W.Hamilton.
A small inclosure. [Written also pightle.] [Obs. or Prov. Eng.]
Previously; before in time; at a time preceding; as,antecedently to conversion. Barrow.
